app.name: Shelf-to-Shop
app.offline: No internet. Check your connection and try again.

signin.title: Your shop's catalog from one video
signin.step_1: Walk past your shelf and say each price.
signin.step_2: We find each item, its price and a clean photo.
signin.step_3: You check, publish, and customers order on WhatsApp.
signin.sample_hint: A kirana shop made from three real 30-second videos. Your copy is private.
signin.shop_hint: Your shop's name, as customers know it
signin.no_sample: The sample shop is not ready yet. Start your own shop instead.

setup.title: Your shop
setup.notice_1: Your shop name, WhatsApp number and the catalog you publish.
setup.notice_2: Videos you record, only to make your catalog. They are deleted after 7 days.
setup.notice_3: You can download or delete everything in Settings.

home.title: Home
home.share_text: See our shop and order on WhatsApp: {{url}}
home.not_live: Your shop is not published yet. Record a video, check the prices, then publish.
home.processing: A video is being turned into items. It takes 2 to 3 minutes.
home.to_check_one: A new video has {{count}} question for you.
home.to_check_other: A new video has {{count}} questions for you.
home.ready_to_publish_one: {{count}} new item is ready. Check it and publish.
home.ready_to_publish_other: {{count}} new items are ready. Check them and publish.
home.first_1: Record a slow video of your shelf, up to 60 seconds.
home.first_2: Say each item's price while it is on screen.
home.first_3: Check the prices we found and publish.
home.chart_label: Visits by day this week: {{views}} visits and {{orders}} order taps in total.
home.no_visits: No visits yet. Share your shop link in a WhatsApp chat or status.
home.no_orders: When customers tap Order on WhatsApp, their favourite items show here.
home.feed_unavailable: The Meta catalog file needs your shop on an https:// address.

videos.title: Videos
videos.empty: No videos yet. Record your first one.
videos.hint: Every video you recorded, what we found in it, and how it was read.

detail.title: Video
detail.heading: Video from {{when}}
detail.recut: New photo from a moment you picked
detail.nothing_heard: No speech found in this video.

source.vision_pairing: Price you said, matched by looking at the video.

items.title: Items
items.needs_photo: Add a photo to show it
items.needs_price: Add a price to show it
items.empty: No items yet. Record a video of your shelf to add them.
items.none_match: No items match. Try another word.
items.add_hint: For things not in a video. Next, add its photo.

sheet.saved_live: Saved. Your shop page is updated.
sheet.remove_confirm: Remove this item from your shop?
sheet.upload_hint: Your own photo of this item
sheet.moment: Pick a moment from your video
sheet.moment_hint: Tap the item in a clearer frame
sheet.pack_hint: Branded goods, from Open Food Facts
sheet.sold_out_hint: Stays on your shop, but customers cannot order it.
sheet.pick_moment: Pick the frame where the item is clearest.
sheet.tap_item: Now tap the middle of the item.
sheet.no_barcode: No barcode found in that photo. Take it closer, or type the numbers.
sheet.no_packs: No pack photos found. Try the brand name only, or the barcode.
sheet.pack_credit: Photos from {{credit}}. The photo credit shows on your shop page.
sheet.mrp_hint: Printed price; shown crossed out when yours is lower.
sheet.pin_hint: First in its section on your shop page.
sheet.hide_hint: Keeps the item here but takes it off your shop page.

record.title: Record your shelf
record.consent_1: Film your stock, not people. Keep customers out of the video.
record.consent_2: Say each price while the item is on screen.
record.consent_3: We keep the video for 7 days to make your catalog, then delete it.
record.preview_hint: Play it once. Can you hear each price clearly?
record.upload_failed: Upload failed. Check your internet and try again.
record.denied_body: Allow camera and microphone for this site in your browser settings, then reload. Or upload a video from your gallery.
record.nocamera_body: Upload a video you already recorded from your gallery.
record.insecure_body: Open this app from an https:// address to use the camera. You can still upload from your gallery.
record.clip_body: Your video is {{length}} long. We make your items from {{clip}} seconds of it. Slide to where your shelf and prices are.
record.clip_hint: Play the video to check this part shows your items and you say the prices.
record.upload_paused: Upload stopped: the connection dropped. Your video is safe on this phone.
record.saved_on_phone: Your video is saved on this phone. Carry on when you have signal; nothing is lost.
record.leftover_body: A video from {{when}} ({{size}} MB) did not finish uploading. It is still on this phone.

processing.title: Making your items
processing.hint: This takes 2 to 3 minutes. You can close the app; your items will be here.

review.all_right: Everything looks right. Publish to put these items on your shop.

q.missing_price: No price heard for {{item}}. What is the price?
q.price_conflict_tag: {{item}}: you said {{first}}, the tag says {{second}}. Which is right?
q.price_conflict_vision: {{item}}: we heard {{first}} and {{second}}. Which is right?
q.price_conflict_multiple: {{item}}: you said {{first}} and {{second}}. Which is right?
q.uncertain_price: {{item}}: we may have misheard {{price}}. Is it right?
q.low_conf_mask: The photo of {{item}} may be cut badly.

review.tap_hint: Tap an item to change its price, name or photo.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Shop name
settings.whatsapp_hint: Orders from your shop page come to this number.
settings.retention_hint: Your items and photos stay. Only the raw videos are deleted.

shop.how: Tap Order on WhatsApp to send the shop your order.
shop.ai_long: The background of this photo was made with AI. The item itself is unedited.
shop.sold_out_long: Sold out right now. Ask the shop on WhatsApp when it is back.
shop.item_gone: This item is no longer in the shop.
shop.empty: This shop has no items yet.
shop.made_with: Made with Shelf-to-Shop from one shelf video.
shop.sent_body: Total {{total}}. Finish sending it in WhatsApp; the shop will confirm.
shop.min_order: Home delivery is for orders of {{min}} or more. You can still pick it up.
shop.privacy: Your name and note go to the shop with your order and nowhere else.

more.title: More
more.videos_hint: Every video and how it was read
more.shop_hint: Hours, delivery, UPI, shop photo, offer
more.sections_hint: Name and order the groups on your shop page
more.share_hint: QR poster for the counter, WhatsApp Status pictures
more.settings_hint: Shop name, WhatsApp number, language, your data

orders.title: Orders
orders.how: Customers add items to a basket on your shop page and send the order to your WhatsApp. Every order also lands here.

profile.title: Shop profile
profile.hint: This shows at the top of your shop page. Customers see changes as soon as you save.
profile.notice_hint: A yellow strip at the very top of your shop page. Leave empty to hide it.
profile.upi_hint: Customers see it in their basket so they can pay you directly.
profile.saved: Saved. Your shop page shows it now.
profile.check_upi: Check the UPI ID. It looks like name@bank.
profile.arrange: Arrange the sections on your shop page

sections.title: Sections
sections.hint: Customers see your items in these groups, in this order. Rename them in English and Hindi.
sections.delete_move_one: Delete it? Its {{count}} item moves to {{name}}.
sections.delete_move_other: Delete it? Its {{count}} items move to {{name}}.
sections.last: This is the only section. Add another one first.

share.title: Share kit
share.not_live: Publish your shop first, then share it from here.
share.qr_hint: Customers scan it with their phone camera and see your shop.
share.qr_alt: QR code that opens your shop page
share.status_hint: Make a picture of one item with its price and your shop link.
share.image_failed: Could not make the picture. Try another item.

poster.headline: Scan to see our items and order on WhatsApp
poster.step: Open your camera, point it at the code, tap the link.
